common: One object only, centered, no other props, no background scene, plenty of empty space around it. No insects, no animals, no people. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no frame. Isolated on a fully transparent background.
style: Style: clean isometric 3D illustration at true isometric angles, simple rounded shapes, minimal detail, soft ambient shading and a subtle soft shadow beneath the object, like a modern tech landing-page illustration. Palette strictly limited to: white, light warm grey (#E9E8E4), mid grey (#B9B7B0), one violet (#7B61E6) used sparingly for accents, and near-black (#1B1B19) only for small details. No other colors.
